sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: The suffix -ban/-ben expresses being inside a place. Use -ban after back-vowel words and -ben after front-vowel words.

The easy mistake here isn’t picking -ban vs -ben on a familiar word — it’s forgetting that the choice depends purely on the noun’s vowels, not on any rule about its meaning. A room and a school don’t have much in common, yet both take -ban, simply because szoba and iskola are both back-vowel words. Let your ear judge the word, not your logic.
